control_parameters.authority_deadline: minimum of image source plus 250ms and detection anchor plus 500ms
control_parameters.fresh_image_low_lease_renewal: unchanged target immediately when old lease <=40ms; new source required
control_parameters.initial_in_zone_pwm: off; engage only on actual face-edge request
control_parameters.initial_equal_target_pwm: off until a distinct trajectory target is ready
control_parameters.visual_loss_stop: PL QUIESCE completes current pulse only; original hardware expiry remains
control_parameters.trajectory_authority: same image stamp; original image/anchor deadline; maximum 4us per admitted image
control_parameters.zone_hold: unchanged current width; no normal PWM power cycle
control_parameters.feedback_reference: current image face position velocity; no face extrapolation
